render-spend-trajectory.ref: No video or image generation call is added and nothing moves spend earlier. The one cost change is LLM tokens on the rendered-QA critic: max_tokens 4,096 → 16,384 with thinking capped at 8,192 (reasoning_effort 'medium' on gemini-2.5-flash), so at most ~16k output tokens per critic call and at most 3 calls per asset by the gate's re-run budget. The cap exists because the uncapped call spent the whole 4,096 on thinking and produced no verdict (finish_reason=length, job 2040001, 15:31:26Z) — tokens bought for nothing. A completed 'repair' verdict on a provider whose beat regen costs credits still routes to the operator spend hold (qualityGate beatRegenCostsCredits → postQaOrchestrator), never to an automatic spend. runReelPreflight's new checks are pure and WARN-only, so prepareCleanReelBrief's regenerate-on-block budget is unchanged; the proof packs are excluded from the rotation, so the lane cannot buy generation for beats declared REAL.

visual-world-trajectory.ref: facelessReelStudio.ts changes are pure checks before any visual-world spend: checkEditorialContract and shotRouteProblems run inside runReelPreflight at the structural and production seams, before attachAutonomousVisualWorld is reached (reelDraftPrep attaches the visual world only after a clean preflight, and a WARN never makes a preflight unclean). shared/editorialContract.test.ts and shared/shotRouter.test.ts prove the three proof packs raise no finding; client/src/__tests__/faceless-reel-studio.test.ts proves the sample brief raises none and that each new warning leaves status 'pass'. No committed pack's trajectory changes.
